1 of the 2678 curves in the deposit have one or more empty samples; they are kept as empty cells, and 48 cycles have an empty event frame. The matched sample's first-analysis values for ankle GVS, GPS and maximal dorsiflexion in the deposit match the paper's other treatment group, so those matched first-analysis numbers are not used as checks.

Table 1 of the paper gives the conservative group's age at the first clinical gait analysis as 6.5 (SD 0.4) and the text as 6.5 (SD 1.9); the SD was therefore not used as a check. The paper's data statement gives the Zenodo DOI as 10.5281/zenodo.10796423 in text and ...10796424 in the link; the record used here is 10796424.
